topic: Evaluating Tenant Quality and Lease Strength
caption:
Lesson 38 examines how to evaluate tenant quality and lease strength so you can protect income and asset value. Learn a practical framework to verify tenant financials and business durability, assess guarantors and personal guarantees, and test for lease clauses that shift costs or create exposure. We walk through rent escalations, expense recoveries, insurance and indemnity provisions, lease term and renewal options, co-tenancy and exclusivity risks, and common red flags to negotiate. Applicable to retail, office, and light industrial assets in Chester County and Montgomery County, this lesson helps standardize due diligence for acquisitions, renewals, and refinancing.
